svg.title: Shinseina Ki — Sacred Heartwood. Draft 4 / Wood classification / forked tree (RUL-2026-10-03-005 recalibration).
svg.desc: 8 skills, 4 purchases, one Advanced Art maximum. Hallowed Seed forks into Fangs of Heartwood then The Forest Devours, or Rooted in Wisdom then Heartwood Awakened. Grasping Roots forks into Rootbound Prey then Judgement of the Grove. No paths converge. Bonuses apply to matching supported tags on all Wood jutsu.

Wood Damage is the primary route because it is the kit's own output and its Burst trait; the doubled Forest Wisdom buff is the secondary route because every point lands twice and also lifts normal jutsu, weapons and basic attacks; Grove's exposure is the tertiary route because it is the kit's only enemy debuff and amplifies allies' hits as well. Recoil, poison, wound, summon and visual rows are unsupported, and Wood Warrior Summon (PVP only) carries no supported row. Grove"]}],"narrow_kit_exception":"Eight nodes and three Advanced Arts rather than ten and four. The kit has three supported tags on six rows (Damage x3, Increase Damage Given x2, Increase Damage Taken x1), so it supports exactly three routes: Hallowed Seed forks into a Wood Damage route (+5) and a Forest Wisdom route (+10% on two always-together self rows); Grasping Roots \u2192 Rootbound Prey \u2192 Judgement of the Grove is a single chain on the only enemy debuff. Hallowed Seed is therefore a universal node (all 8 legal full builds). A Hidden Art leaf under Grasping Roots, to give that root a 4-BP closure without it, would be filler; every single-tag candidate was checked against the legal builds: any Increase Damage Taken leaf breaks the +10% ceiling; an Increase Damage Given leaf at +1% leaves 06, 07, 08 plus the leaf dominated, at +2% twins 01, 06, 07, 08, at +3% or +4% twins or dominates Rooted in Wisdom's hybrids, and at +5% twins Heartwood Awakened's build 01, 04, 05, 06; a Damage leaf at +1 serves only 06, 07, 08 plus the leaf (its three hybrids are dominated), at +2 twins Fangs of Heartwood's hybrids, at +3 twins 01, 02, 03, 06 and at +4 or more exceeds +5 Damage. The layout is kept: Burst and Amplification each have two fourth-purchase choices, the exposure route has one, and three distinct complete builds exist, one per Advanced Art.","design_notes":["Node split: 2 Foundations, 3 Hidden Arts, 3 Advanced Arts. Hallowed Seed (+2% Increase Damage Given on both Forest Wisdom rows) forks into Fangs of Heartwood \u2192 The Forest Devours (+2 / +3 Damage) and Rooted in Wisdom \u2192 Heartwood Awakened (+3% / +5% Increase Damage Given). Grasping Roots \u2192 Rootbound Prey \u2192 Judgement of the Grove (+2% / +3% / +5% Increase Damage Taken, +1 Damage on the capstone) is the enemy-facing chain. Every Advanced Art is 3 BP deep; any two cost 5 or 6 BP, so a build holds at most one.","Recalibration under RUL-2026-10-03-005: Hallowed Seed's +1 Damage was removed, so the Damage route is the default +5 (Fangs of Heartwood +2, The Forest Devours +3) and no allocation exceeds +5 Damage (Judgement of the Grove's +1 cannot join the full Damage route). The Forest Wisdom route moves from +7% to the +10% band (Hallowed Seed +2%, Rooted in Wisdom +3%, Heartwood Awakened +5%); the exposure chain keeps its +2% / +3% / +5% ladder to +10%.","Interactions (SOURCE_MECHANICS \u00a73/\u00a73b): Forest Wisdom row 0 (no element, Highest filter) matches the kit's Wood hits, every element-less hit of any stat (basic attacks, weapons, normal jutsu) and any elemental hit of the caster's highest stat; row 1 (Earth/None/Water/Wood) matches those elements and None. Each matching row multiplies the hit by 1 + power/100 and same-tag rows all apply, so both Increase Damage Given rows and Grove's exposure compound (\u00d71.35\u00b3 \u2248 \u00d72.46 at base); the bloodline passive (25+0.15/level) multiplies last (SOURCE_MECHANICS \u00a73b).","Delivery and timing: every jutsu has cooldown 7, and buff/debuff rows act only in the two rounds after their cast round (\u00a73b). Forest Wisdom is a 40 AP SELF cast realized on the caster; it lifts hits in the next two rounds, never a hit in its own round. Serpent and Eternal Forest are 60 AP single-target hits at range 4. Guardian's Grove is a 60 AP radius-1 circle on an OTHER_USER target at range 4, applied once to each non-caster in it; its exposure never amplifies its own damage row.","Fourth purchases: Burst (01, 02, 03) finishes with Rooted in Wisdom (buffs 40%; solo-strongest) or Grasping Roots (exposure 37%; team play); Amplification (01, 04, 05) with Fangs of Heartwood (hits 42 / 42 / 52 EP) or Grasping Roots; Exposure (01, 06, 07, 08) only with Hallowed Seed. No-capstone hybrids: 01, 02, 04, 06 (42 / 42 / 52 EP, buffs 40%, exposure 37%), 01, 02, 06, 07 (42 / 42 / 52 EP, buffs 37%, exposure 40%), 01, 04, 06, 07 (buffs 40%, exposure 40%). 8 legal full allocations, all non-dominated, every node in one."],"risks":["Classification: Wood is the single qualifying element; sharing it with Nature's Blessing is expected (RUL-2026-10-03-005). 4 of 6 kit rows carry Wood; Forest Wisdom row 0 and Grove's exposure are element-less and need the proposed jutsu-classification resolver. Wood Warrior Summon carries no Wood row, so it would qualify only through an authored jutsu classification (ENGINE_GAP_REGISTER G1), though it has no supported row. Off-kit Wood coverage (NORMAL/SPECIAL/EVENT/FORBIDDEN) is unverified.","Ally hazard: Guardian's Grove row 1 (Wood damage, AOE_CIRCLE_SPAWN, OTHER_USER) has friendly fire absent (= ALL) and the poison row explicit ALL, so allies in the circle take both; the ENEMIES exposure row skips them and the caster is never a target. Fangs of Heartwood, The Forest Devours and Judgement of the Grove raise it (up to 45 EP); positioning, not the node, decides.","Increase Damage Given stacking: Heartwood Awakened's route puts both Forest Wisdom rows at 45%, compounding to \u00d71.45 \u00d7 1.45 \u2248 \u00d72.10 (\u00d71.82 at base) on hits both rows match (the kit's Wood hits and every element-less hit) for two rounds, before the passive multiplies last (BATTLE_TAG_STACKING on at the pin). Judgement of the Grove makes Grove's area exposure 45% for two rounds and amplifies allies' non-pierce hits as well as the caster's. Not simulated.","Universal opener: every legal full build contains Hallowed Seed because the exposure chain has no other prerequisite-closed fourth purchase. Every single-tag leaf under Grasping Roots was checked and rejected as dominated, a twin, a sliver serving one build, or a ceiling breach (narrow-kit exception), so the brief's preference for no mandatory opener is not met.","Damage is formula-calculated (sqrt stat scaling), then Forest Wisdom and Grove's exposure multiply it in turn and the bloodline passive multiplies last, so +5 Damage is not a linear +5; realized value depends on stats. Serpent's recoil 40% and Eternal Forest's wound 25% are unsupported and unchanged. No combat simulation was performed.","Ranked modes: skill-tree and bloodline effects are skipped in RANKED_PVP and RANKED_SPARRING at the pin, so no node applies there. g.text: Foundations support. Hidden Arts focus. Advanced Arts define.
1 BP each · Acquire points with silver
Bonuses apply to matching supported tags on all Wood jutsu. Combat scopes stay unchanged.
Finish a path in 3 purchases. Spend your fourth on support or a sibling Hidden Art.
Any two Advanced Arts require at least 5 points. Your limit is 4.
Each skill purchased once · Only your current bloodline unlocks · No converging paths
Examples are choices, not locked presets. Advanced Arts are optional.
The Forest Devours path + Rooted in Wisdom
Heartwood Awakened path + Fangs of Heartwood
Judgement of the Grove path + Hallowed Seed
IDG: Increase Damage Given · IDT: Increase Damage Taken
FINAL TAG VALUES ON THE SHINSEINA KI KIT
Jutsu level 25 · main-tree bonuses and bloodline passives excluded
Wisdom · Increase Damage Given (each of 2 effects)
Static bonuses: a 35% tag with +5% becomes 40%. A 40 EP jutsu with +5 Damage becomes 45EP.
Proposed behavior: needs a jutsu-classification potency resolver. The current resolver matches each effect's own elements.
8 legal four-skill allocations · 3 Advanced Arts available · Combat tuning remains experimental
Draft 4 / Wood classification / forked tree (RUL-2026-10-03-005 recalibration)
